principle: Harness owns reusable AI contracts and pipelines; Engine owns runtime/API/session transport.

features.name: Agent-resumable harness control files
features.description: Add AGENTS.md, feature_list.json, progress.md, and init.ps1 so future agent sessions can start, verify, scope, and hand off reliably.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md documents startup workflow, scope rules, verification, and handoff.
feature_list.json contains ordered finish/improvement roadmap.
progress.md records current status and verification evidence.
init.ps1 exposes check, test, fmt, and all modes.
features.evidence: 2026-05-20: Added AGENTS.md, feature_list.json, progress.md, and init.ps1. Fixed init.ps1 to fail on nonzero command exits. Fixed yaatal-memory doctest imports. Verified feature_list.json parses and .\init.ps1 -Mode all passed cargo fmt --all --check, cargo check --workspace --all-targets, and cargo test --workspace -- --test-threads=1.

features.name: Dangerous tool feature gates
features.description: Move shell, file-write, git, web-fetch, and search built-ins behind explicit Cargo features or Engine-supplied adapters.
acceptance_criteria: Default tool registration cannot expose shell, file-write, git, web-fetch, or search.
Tests prove unsafe tools are unavailable by default.
Documentation explains R&D vs production tool registration.
features.evidence: 2026-05-20: Added yaatal-tools Cargo features default/safe-tools/file-read/session-note/local-shell/file-write/git/network/web-fetch/web-search/r-and-d-tools/all-builtin-tools. Made reqwest and urlencoding optional network dependencies. Changed ToolExecutor::register_builtin to return Result<(), ToolError>; disabled built-ins return PermissionDenied naming the required feature. Default tests prove file_read and session_note register while shell, file_write, git, web_fetch, and search are rejected and absent from list_tools. Feature-gated tests prove file_write, git, web_fetch, and search register when enabled; shell registration is also covered. Verified cargo check -p yaatal-tools --no-default-features, cargo test -p yaatal-tools, cargo test -p yaatal-tools --all-features, cargo test --workspace -- --test-threads=1, and .\init.ps1 -Mode all.

features.name: Durable session memory
features.description: Replace process-local session notes with a trait-backed durable store suitable for Engine resume flows.
acceptance_criteria: Session notes survive process restart in a file-backed or SQLite-backed implementation.
SessionNoteTool uses the store abstraction.
Resume tests cover write, restart/reopen, and recall.
features.evidence: 2026-05-21: Replaced process-local SessionNoteTool state with a public SessionNoteStore trait and FileSessionNoteStore JSON implementation. Default SessionNoteTool registration now writes under the executor workspace at .yaatal/session_notes.json, keyed by RequestContext metadata session_id with request_id fallback. Added SessionNoteTool::with_store for custom adapters, temp-file replacement for writes, .yaatal/ gitignore entry, docs for session_id/path behavior, and tests for executor reopen persistence, direct store reopen, and session-id isolation. Verified cargo test -p yaatal-tools, cargo check -p yaatal-tools --no-default-features, cargo test -p yaatal-tools --all-features, cargo test --workspace -- --test-threads=1, and .\init.ps1 -Mode all.

features.name: Engine integration example
features.description: Add an example showing how Yaatal Engine supplies context and adapters while calling Harness search/tool/memory contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Example compiles with workspace tests.
Harness does not own auth, WebSocket, Loco, or deployment concerns.
RequestContext fields required from Engine are documented.

features.name: Bo-Plex evaluation fixtures
features.description: Add small fixtures for search ranking, tool-call parsing, and voice trigger-to-tool response paths.
acceptance_criteria: Search fixture reports MRR/NDCG.
Tool-call parser fixture validates strict JSON calls.
Voice fixture validates trigger -> tool -> response contract with mocks.

features.name: Generator/evaluator loop prototype
features.description: Add a feature-gated minimal sprint contract with mocked generator/evaluator roles.
acceptance_criteria: TaskSpec, SprintContract, and SprintResult contracts exist.
Mocked generator/evaluator loop has pass and fail tests.
The prototype is feature-gated and not enabled by default.

features.name: Internal Symphony R&D workflow contract
features.description: Add a repo-owned WORKFLOW.md and internal notes that adapt Symphony-style orchestration to Yaatal-Harness feature development without making it a BoPlex product surface.
acceptance_criteria: WORKFLOW.md defines the local tracker, run lifecycle, subagent pattern, proof-of-work requirements, verification gates, and stop conditions.
AGENTS.md points future agents to WORKFLOW.md during startup.
Documentation states this is internal Harness R&D infrastructure, not product runtime.
A future runner is described as optional and not required for the current setup.
features.evidence: 2026-05-21: Added WORKFLOW.md as a manual Symphony-lite contract for Yaatal-Harness R&D. Added docs/internal-symphony-rd.md mapping Symphony concepts to feature_list.json, progress.md, init.ps1, and Codex subagents. Updated AGENTS.md startup and working rules to include WORKFLOW.md and bounded sidecar subagent use. Verified feature_list.json parses and .\init.ps1 -Mode check passed.
